article.title: When party to whom notice given is dead.
article.content:
97When party to whom notice given is dead.

Section 97  ·  Chapter VIII  ·  page 22 of the Act
when the party to whom notice of dishonour is dispatched is dead, but the party dispatching the notice is ignorant of his death, the notice is sufficient.
